scope.note: Classified solution provenance/quality from existing local card metadata only; problem cards were not edited.

type_definitions.official_complete_or_near_complete: Official/archive-derived solution present and checked, or near-complete restored official solution.
type_definitions.official_outline_needs_work: Official/archive solution exists but is compressed, outline-like, incomplete, downgraded, or marked for human review.
type_definitions.unofficial_published: Solution comes from a non-official published/forum/external source.
type_definitions.ai_original: AI-authored or AI-reconstructed solution without a reliable official/published solution marker.
type_definitions.ai_heavy_external_theorem: AI-authored/reconstructed solution whose main proof depends on a substantial named external theorem/reference.
type_definitions.no_solution_hard: No solution is stored in the card; usually a hard/no-solution item.
